prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D body sprite for ENEMY-007, the Hunting Hound in Survival Arena FIELD-001. Use the supplied villager and woodcutter images only as style references, not as edit targets. Create ONE athletic human-owned hunting dog, clearly a quadruped, alert and determined, poised to dash toward screen-right and slightly toward the viewer. Strong compact silhouette that fits a single contact circle: sturdy chest, muscular legs, head forward, tail short or curled close; no exaggerated long thin protrusions. Three-quarter top-down view consistent with the references, all four paws visible and on approximately one ground plane, animation-ready stance rather than a frozen airborne leap. Brown and warm grey fur with a simple neat leather collar; no green goblin palette. Match the established hand-painted storybook cutout look: dark plum-brown lively outline, 2–3 broad matte color masses, simple cel shading, restrained paper texture, warm upper-front light. Readable at 128–160 display pixels. Center on square transparent RGBA canvas with generous padding around every edge. No background, ground, baked shadow, text, UI, speed lines, dust, glow, extra characters or cropped parts.
